evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/lib/errorHandler.ts:56-141 defines the ENTIRE client-side error catalogue (ERROR_MESSAGES + DEFAULT_ERROR) as hardcoded English title/message string literals (e.g. INVALID_CREDENTIALS 'The email or password you entered is incorrect.', RATE_LIMITED 'You have made too many requests. Please wait before trying again.', NETWORK_ERROR 'Unable to connect to the server. Please check your internet connection.'). parseApiError (:149), parseErrorResponse (:232-245), and parseHttpStatusError (:270-347) all return these raw English strings, and the 429 branch at :172-174 additionally builds a hardcoded English template `Please wait ${retryAfter} seconds before trying again.` - none of these pass through react-i18next.

These strings are rendered verbatim to end users. Confirmed consumer frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/features/accounting/pages/AccountingInvoiceManagementPage.tsx:46-51 and :61-66 does `const parsed = parseApiError(error); showToast({ type: 'error', message: parsed.message })` - the English catalogue message goes straight into the user-facing error toast with no t() wrapping.

The app is fully internationalised elsewhere: `grep -rl useTranslation frontend/apps/ppt-web/src --include='*.tsx'` returns ~300 components, and errorHandler.ts imports/uses no i18n at all. Net effect: every client-derived API/network/rate-limit error toast renders English-only regardless of the user's selected locale - a consistent i18n gap across the whole app's error surface.

Fix: key the catalogue by error code and resolve messages through i18n at the render site (e.g. return `code` from errorHandler and call `t('errors.' + code)` in showToast callers, with the current English strings seeded into the locale bundles), or inject a translator into parseApiError. Also i18n the retry-after template as an interpolated ICU string. Low severity (no functional break; UX/locale-correctness only), medium confidence (static - traced catalogue -> parseApiError -> one confirmed toast consumer; the exhaustive set of consumers was not enumerated).
